summary: Tested 'Cambio Password Profilo' end-to-end. Backend: all 10 tests pass (4 existing password_reset + 6 new in test_password_change_extra.py) covering: 401 unauthenticated, 400 wrong current with remaining-attempts message, 429 lockout after 5 wrong attempts (15 min), 422 weak new password, 400 same-as-current, 200 success with other_sessions_closed, seed_doctor idempotency after password_changed_at (new password survives reseed, old .env password rejected), 2FA still required at login after change. Frontend: ProfileMenu renders correctly for parent (no security item) and doctor (security item present and opens Sicurezza e GDPR panel). ChangePasswordDialog live rules (change-rule-len/letter/digit/special with data-pass) update correctly, strength bar works, change-password-same warning shows when new==current, change-password-match hint shows mismatch, submit disabled until valid, wrong current shows change-password-error with remaining attempts, success shows toast 'Password aggiornata · N altre sessioni chiuse' and closes dialog, current session stays logged in (GET /api/auth/me = 200). Dialog renders correctly at both 1440px and 390px viewports. State restored (doctor + parent passwords, 2FA still ON).
critical_code_review_comments: password_reset.py change(): verify_password(new, old_hash) is used to detect same-as-current only AFTER current_password was validated correctly, which is correct and avoids leaking info. OK.
ChangePasswordDialog uses a single `show` state for all three password fields: toggling reveals current/new/confirm together. Minor UX point, not a bug.
seed_doctor/seed_admin correctly preserve name update (not password) when password_changed_at is set. Good.
